desc.en: mGBA is a Game Boy Advance emulator focused on accuracy, performance and compatibility. This libretro core also supports Game Boy and Game Boy Color games. BIOS files are optional.
desc.zh: mGBA 是一款注重模拟精度、性能和兼容性的 Game Boy Advance 模拟器。此 Libretro 核心也支持 Game Boy 和 Game Boy Color 游戏，无需 BIOS 即可运行。
